hack.root_cause: Flash loan → spot price manipulation of Solidex USDC/DEI AMM pool (used as oracle) → user positions liquidated
hack.description: Deus DAO's DEI lending contract lost ~$3M when an attacker flash-loaned from the very AMM pool the contract used as its price oracle — crashing the oracle price mid-transaction and liquidating all user positions at once.
